😏 𝐖𝐡𝐨 𝐊𝐧𝐞𝐰 𝐘𝐨𝐮 𝐂𝐨𝐮𝐥𝐝 𝐃𝐨 𝐓𝐡𝐢𝐬?!
𝐏𝐫𝐨 𝐓𝐢𝐩𝐬 & 𝐓𝐫𝐢𝐜𝐤𝐬 𝐕𝐨𝐥. 𝟏

One of the best feelings in gaming is discovering an
easier way to do something you’ve been doing for
ages!

We’re bringing you our first collection of Pro Tips &
Tricks. Let’s see how many of these you already
know! 👀
1. Get free Blacksmith’s Scrolls from the final Chest of
the Weekly Quests.
2. Place the Ruby Mine Decor in your Territory to
collect Rubies daily. Higher levels give you more
Rubies!
3. Lords Title stats remain active even when the title
isn’t displayed or equipped.
4. Villagers with glowing feet at the entrance share
the same Facility for both stats, and their stats are
much better!
5. Use Castle Skills before entering Frostfield
Battlefield for the first time to keep them active
throughout the battle.
6. Castle Skill usage also counts toward Arena and
Carriage attacks.
7. Save your Resource Chests! The higher your Castle
Lv., the more resources you’ll get when opening them.
8. During Dark Empire Invasion, both your Individual
Score and Guild Points must reach the required
Milestones to claim Rewards.
9. Tired of waiting for Hero Soulcasting upgrades?
Try Auto Research!
10. When your full Relic Set reaches 5 white stars and
is at a higher level than your enemy’s, all enemy Relic
effects are halved!
11. Don’t forget to upgrade Hostess Skills! They boost
all your Queues without needing to be dispatched.
